messages.text: Where is my order? Order #Shop····, email (email hidden)
I'll pull up the current status.

Here's where it stands, Christopher. Your Gamma parcel (3 units plus the Power K.) left Chattanooga on October 15 and is still with the carrier after that failed delivery attempt in (address hidden). Tracking: (tracking link hidden) . It's worth checking with your local depot for a redelivery, they usually retry.

The B30 ships October 30. You can follow that batch on its way to us here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Want me to chase the carrier on the Gamma parcel?
Handed to the team · Carrier chase on a failed delivery attempt is not something I can do from here.

Done, I've put the carrier chase on your Gamma parcel in front of the team with the tracking number, so they can get a redelivery arranged or open a lost-package check. A colleague picks it up and the answer comes to (email hidden), so you don't need to sit here waiting.

The B30 is unaffected and still ships October 30.

Perfect.  It said they would supposedly try redelivery the next day, but it's now been two full days since then and still nothing.  And the "no access" is definitely just a filler description because my house has easy open access.

Understood, and "no access" on an easy-access house usually means the driver never made a real attempt. Two days with no movement after a promised redelivery is also when a parcel can quietly start heading back to the warehouse, so it's worth pushing now.

I've added that to what the team has on it: two days stalled, no genuine access issue, redelivery promised and not made. They'll work it with the carrier and come back to you by email.

Anything on the tracking page showing a new scan today?
Nope, absolutely nothing.  Last thing it shows is the no access 2 days ago

That's a stalled parcel, not a delivery problem, and the team has exactly that in hand with the tracking number. They'll push the carrier for a trace and a redelivery.

Nothing more is needed from you tonight. If a scan does appear before they write, you'll see it on the same link.

Sorry it's dragged like this, Christopher. The Gammas and the Power K. are a short hop from you, and the B30 is still on for October 30.
